description: Validation rules for itsm-itil tickets and WSJF ranking.

rules: type must be one of incident | problem | change
state must be valid for the type's state machine (see references/lifecycle.md)
a problem in state 'known-error' MUST have a non-empty workaround
incidents[] only on problems; problem/change links must reference existing ticket ids
filename must be docs/<type-plural>/<NNN>-<slug>.<state>.md (or the per-state subdir variant)
value, time, risk, size are relative (e.g. modified Fibonacci 1..20); size > 0
verifying and parked tickets get score 0 (excluded from active ranking)
rank descending; ties break by severity then age
